Canvas.ReferenceDisplayHint.zh: 以当前格长和横纵数量，在所选屏幕中心重置透视；多个活动屏幕时可用下拉菜单选择。
Canvas.ReferenceDisplayHint.en: Reset perspective at the selected screen center using the current cell size and counts. Choose a display when multiple screens are active.

Canvas.MultiMonitorHelp.zh: 拖动中央把手可整体移动透视框；重置默认使用主屏，多个活动屏幕时可选择具体屏幕。
Canvas.MultiMonitorHelp.en: Drag the central handle to move the perspective frame. Reset defaults to the primary screen; choose a display when multiple screens are active.

Canvas.DragBoundary.zh: 已到达透视边界；拖动中央把手可整体移动。
Canvas.DragBoundary.en: Perspective limit reached. Drag the center handle to move the canvas.
